module: Tile generator of the freeroam selector: one tile per spawn point of each level in core_levels.getList(). It also builds a level's details panel (size, biome, roads, country…), the "Start Freeroam" and "Configure" buttons, search text filtering and the opening of the level configuration window. A modder can plug their own buttons into it via the hook onFreeroamSelectorGetDetails.
notes: The tiles are valid for the freeroamSelector backend, not for gameplaySelector (validBackends). They are therefore added without a test on backend.backendName.
If several spawn points of the same level are marked as default, an error "Default spawnpoint count is greater than 1" is logged.
The level size is displayed in km (metric) or miles depending on the uiUnitLength setting; a negative dimension means "infinite".
If backend.getCustomDetailsButtons() returns buttons, they entirely replace the default buttons.
The tile of the level currently selected in freeroam_freeroamConfigurator receives cornerIcon = "road".

onGameplaySelectorGetTiles.desc: Hook called when the selector collects its tiles. Walks through the levels and, for each spawn point, adds a tile (name "point (level)", preview, key spawnPoint_<level>_<object>, region, map size, beamNG, Camshaft or bug icons).

items.desc: List of tiles to complete (modified in place).

onGameplaySelectorGetDetails.desc: Hook called when a level tile's details are opened. Finds the level and its spawn point, fills in title, description, preview, favorite, specifications and labels, then adds the "Start Freeroam" (freeroam_freeroam.startFreeroamByName) and "Configure" (opens menu.freeroamconfigurator) buttons. Emits the hook onFreeroamSelectorGetDetails so that other extensions modify the data.

details.desc: List of details blocks to complete.

backend.desc: Backend offering isFavourite, trackRecent, getUiData and getCustomDetailsButtons.

onFilterCustomLevelTiles.desc: Filter hook declared by the tiles (filterHook). If the search text, case-insensitively, appears in the level's biome, suggested use, characteristics, roads or country, sets result.match to true.

searchText.desc: Text entered; empty or nil, the function does nothing.

result.desc: Table whose match field is set to true on a match.

onFreeroamSelectorOpenedWithItemDetails.desc: Hook called when the freeroam selector opens with stored details. Reopens the level configuration window with the level, the spawn point and itemDetails.

itemDetails.desc: Stored details; no effect if nil.

backend.desc: Calling backend (unused, the name "freeroamSelector" is hardcoded).

openLevelConfigurationPopup.desc: Triggers the UI event openLevelConfigurationPopup with the level data to display the configuration window.

levelData.desc: Table with levelName, spawnPointObjectName, level, spawnPoint, backendName, itemDetails.

setAlwaysShowDialogue.desc: Sets the backend's default action: "configureFreeroam" if newValue is true, otherwise "startFreeroam" (via ui_gridSelector.setDisplayDataOption). Logs an error if backendName is missing.

newValue.desc: true to always show the configuration window.
